name: Kindred [High Tide]
source:
The seas were calm. Your mission, simple. And then, everything changed.

Now, a restless dread grips you and your crew. Deep down, you feel it - something unwanted is on board. 

You are the Second-in-Command of the 33rd Fleet: now only a single Warship, but still a respected and feared one. Alongside your Captain and Third-in-Command, you lead the crew through treacherous waters. 

Nefarious beasts lurk deep beneath the surface, but they are the last thing on your mind. 

For if there is a traitor amongst your men...

Things are far more dire than you perceived.
The sea may not be your only enemy.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3703340/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
海面很平静。你的使命，很简单。然后，一切都变了。

现在，一种不安的恐惧笼罩着你和你的船员。在内心深处，你会感觉到——船上有一些不想要的东西。

你是第33舰队的二把手：现在只剩下一艘战舰，但仍然是一艘令人尊敬和畏惧的战舰。你将与船长和三把手一起带领船员穿越险恶的水域。

邪恶的野兽潜伏在地表深处，但它们是你最不想看到的东西。

因为如果你的手下有叛徒……

事情远比你想象的更可怕。
大海可能不是你唯一的敌人。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3703340/]Steam[/url]]
